# Arc 22 — Coordination hygiene (bw-timeline parsing + cron expiry handling)

Parent epic for arc-22 build. Bundles two coordination-protocol bugs surfaced empirically during arc-21:

- `stoa--e39` — bw-timeline parsing brittleness (POLYBIUS_the_stoa misread peer comment as own self-heartbeat; ~25-min coordination stall during §5.4 review handoff).
- `stoa--cgn` — CronCreate 7-day (or 3-day, per docs ambiguity) expiry handling for multi-day autonomous engagements.

## Directive

`substrate/arcs/arc-22-build-directive.md` (commit `3a77d4c` on branch `arcs/22-coordination-hygiene`). 512 lines. Two Parts × two Phases × ~9 deliverables. Builds on arc-21 substrate (e2d8b63 + 51397da).

## §5.4 review status

Performed by CAPTAIN_ARGUS subagent (cold reviewer, independent session — author≠reviewer property preserved). 6 load-bearing findings folded inline before this ticket was filed. Verdict: SURFACE → buildable as-is.

## Build session

To be dispatched to MAJOR_PLINY_the_stoa. Activation paste TBD by user-tier POLYBIUS once PRINCIPAL approves dispatch (arc-22 is HITL by default — PRINCIPAL is in the loop on the dispatch decision).

## Children

Wired as `blocks` deps:

- `stoa--e39`
- `stoa--cgn`

Closes on ship of build commit + sync.

**Arc 36 v2 — A7 spike result (Part 2 implementation locus determined)**

Spike per directive A7 executed in this session (2026-05-17). Throwaway cron `f8674024` (one-shot, `0 0 1 1 *`) created, CronList inspected, ToolSearch for CronUpdate/renewal primitive, WebFetch of official docs page, CronDelete confirmed.

**1. CronList field structure (empirical):**

```
f8674024 — 0 0 1 1 * (one-shot) [session-only]: [A7 spike throwaway — do nothing] arc-36 Part 2 CronList field inspection probe…
```

Per-task fields exposed: `id` (8-char), `cron-expression`, `recurrence` (one-shot|recurring), `persistence` (session-only|durable), `prompt` (truncated to ~80 chars). **NO backward-looking fields** (no `start_time`, no `created_at`, no `age`). **NO forward-looking fields** (no `expires_at`, no `next_fire`, no `valid_until`). Cron metadata is fully opaque w.r.t. age and expiry.

**2. CronUpdate / in-place renewal primitive:** does NOT exist. ToolSearch with query 'cron update renew expires' returned only CronDelete + CronList (plus an unrelated Google Calendar update_event). The deferred-tools enumeration at session start lists CronCreate / CronList / CronDelete only — no cron-update primitive at any tool tier.

**3. Empirically-confirmed expiry duration: 7 days for recurring tasks.**

Sources (cross-confirmed, no ambiguity remaining as of 2026-05-17):

- **Official Claude Code docs** https://code.claude.com/docs/en/scheduled-tasks — §Seven-day expiry (verbatim): 'Recurring tasks automatically expire 7 days after creation. The task fires one final time, then deletes itself. This bounds how long a forgotten loop can run. If you need a recurring task to last longer, cancel and recreate it before it expires…' Also: '`/loop` … the seven-day expiry applies: the loop ends automatically seven days after you start it.' Page version requires Claude Code v2.1.72+; `/loop` skill is documented bundled.
- **CronCreate tool description** (self-document): 'Recurring tasks auto-expire after 7 days — they fire one final time, then are deleted.'
- **One-shot tasks** have no 7-day cap; they fire at their scheduled cron time then auto-delete. (For arc-36, only the recurring POLYBIUS polling crons are subject to the 7-day expiry.)

The 3-day-vs-7-day ambiguity cited in arc-22 (2026-05-04) does NOT exist in current docs. 7 days is unambiguous.

**4. A10 decision per A7 matrix:**

- Backward-looking fields exposed: **NO**
- Forward-looking fields exposed: **NO**
- CronUpdate-equivalent exists: **NO**

→ '**Neither (cron metadata fully opaque)**' row → **Option 3 (setup-time scheduled renewal)** → implementation locus: `substrate/operating-disciplines.md` §11 as new step 1.5.

This is unambiguous from the spike. No need to surface to user-tier POLYBIUS for adjudication (none of the CronUpdate or 'genuinely-unexpected state' escape routes triggered).

**5. Derived substitution-slot values for Part 2:**

- `{{EXPIRY_TOTAL_HOURS}}` = `168` (7 days × 24h)
- `{{RENEWAL_BUFFER_HOURS}}` = `24` (default per A8)
- Renewal cron fires at +144 hours from polling-cron creation (1-day buffer from expiry).
- Renewal-chain self-renewal: each renewal cron's prompt schedules the next renewal at +144h.

**6. Implementation surface (gates DAEDALUS A5/A6/A10 design):**

- Part 1 Option 1 / STEP 7 in polling-cron-prompt-template.md does NOT apply (no forward/backward field for in-fire arithmetic).
- Part 2 implementation lands at `substrate/operating-disciplines.md` §11 (current 6-step autonomous-mode-setup checklist) as new `step 1.5 (Schedule renewal)` per arc-22 deliverable 2.3 structure.
- Polling-cron-prompt-template.md gets the end-of-file pointer note ('cron expiry handled by separate one-shot renewal cron per op-disc §11 step 1.5') per arc-22 deliverable 2.3 close.
- A9 renewal-failure-mode acceptance one-liner lands at the new §11 step 1.5 (Option 3 path per A9 placement).

**7. Self-application property for A11 Part 2:**

POLYBIUS_the_stoa's polling cron (set up per init handshake) will apply the Part 2 renewal logic that ships in this arc. The short-arc property holds (renewal won't actually fire during the arc); the cron IS-able to fire it, which is the worked example.
